description: Creates a private HTML review in the configured owner workspace and returns an owner-only review URL. It never creates or returns a reviewer share link. Handoffs are immutable and additive-only within agent-context/v1; execution packages carry approved work out and regeneration results carry proposed artifacts back. feedback_type and severity are reserved/non-normative, so consumers must not branch on them.

file_name.description: Optional source filename for the artifact.

idempotency_key.description: Stable 8-200 character key; reuse it only when retrying the same artifact.

name: create_review
